How to read this report:
* **In-sample rows.** v1.1 was refitted on 2003-2018: its 2017-18 (validation) numbers in section 12 are in-sample and marked so; section 16A shows v1.1 on test only.
* **Test years.** 2020-22 is a reused development test (TriFrame read it; every model since v1 was scored on it). It is a diagnostic, not proof; only the forward test and the sealed 2023+ evaluation are clean.
* **p-values.** Section 13A: one-sided month-block bootstrap (the share of resamples at or below zero), Holm-adjusted over the eight comparisons of each row set. Section 16A: (r + 1) / (N + 1) against 300 null books (smallest possible 0.003); beating the null books means ranking better than chance after the same costs, not profitability (see 'profitable').
* **Seeds.** Every fusion number moves by about 0.001 between seeds; differences smaller than the seed SD in 13A are not distinguishable.
* **R versus bps.** R divides by each trade's stop distance, so quiet stocks weigh more; bps weigh every trade by capital. Opposite signs mean quiet stocks lost while volatile stocks won.
* **Direction skill (gate 3).** No horizon of v1.1 or v2 is both validated (2017-18) and replicated (2020-22); the dashboard's engine therefore trades no direction (D-057). The frozen models are unchanged.
* **Forward test.** Late rows are flagged and never scored; v3_fund's 9 late rows are the 1-stock file of session 2026-11-05 (incident D-045).
